facts.business: Purple Wave Infocom Limited is a technology-driven company engaged in digital Professional Audio-Visual (PRO AV) integration, distribution, and post-sales support services, offering end-to-end solutions including consulting, design, engineering, system integration, deployment, management, and on-site support, along with a SaaS platform 'Streampurple' for live streaming and digital content management.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter drawing attention to Note 2 regarding GST proceedings initiated by DGGI with a demand of Rs 838.64 lakhs for period 01.04.2020 to 31.03.2025; management believes demand is not sustainable based on legal opinion, no provision made.

key_risks: Business Risk: Highly competitive Pro AV industry with domestic and multinational participation requiring continuous innovation
Technology Risk: Rapid changes in communication technologies, software platforms and hardware solutions may lead to product obsolescence
Project Execution Risk: Large technology integration projects involve multiple stakeholders, procurement timelines and site dependencies; delays may affect execution schedules and working capital
Supply Chain Risk: Global supply chain disruptions and fluctuations in component availability may affect procurement timelines and costs
Financial Risk: Delays in customer payments may impact cash flows and working capital management
Foreign Exchange Risk: Exposure to exchange rate fluctuations due to procurement of imported equipment and technology
Cybersecurity Risk: Increasing digitization exposes business to cyber threats, data breaches and system disruptions
Regulatory Risk: Changes in taxation, import policies, environmental regulations or other statutory requirements may impact business operations
